subject: 府城玉皇庙二十八宿彩塑之虚日鼠
caption: 泽州玉皇庙 · 虚日鼠
元代 · 二十八宿代表彩塑

sources.author: 晋城新闻客户端，晋城市人民政府转载；摄影者未单独署名

source_note: 官方图注明确所选像为虚日鼠。以单尊代表二十八宿，非全殿合影；不将1076年玉皇庙重建纪年套于元代彩塑。发式、衣袍、手势与小鼠轮廓据实拍概括，移除彩绘图案与表面斑驳；原提示词对外侧袖口局部的残缺判断较保守，生成以照片实际小鼠形态呈现。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: museum heritage sculpture line illustration for 访古.
Image1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY: use its elegant delicate slightly organic fine contours, restraint and generous white space. Image2 is ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY: the authentic historic Yuan-period polychrome clay statue XU RI SHU 虚日鼠 from the Twenty-eight Mansions at Fucheng Yuhuang Temple, Zezhou, Shanxi, as photographed in the official Jinchen government museum heritage feature.
Draw this single fully robed seated historic statue with its actual gentle frontal face, swept-back hair, long hanging hair along the cheeks, crossed broad collar and wide draped sleeves. Preserve the actual existing hand lifted near the chest on viewer-left, and the broken/missing hand area at the outer viewer-left sleeve exactly as photographed; do not reconstruct missing fingers or limbs. Preserve the layered long garment, hanging sash knot and the contour of the robe as it covers the seated legs. No extra mouse, no halo, no crown, no throne invented beneath the photo's visible robe edge. Represent the sculpture only, with faithful original pose and photographed proportions, not a living person or generic Buddha.
Make a refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE contour drawing. Keep every surface, hair and recess WHITE; a few thin internal lines describe major folds. No dark filled hair or shadows, no gray shading, hatching, grain, texture, color or gradients. Omit painted cloth brocade, peeling-paint marks and dense tiny patterns. Preserve the main robe border with a simple thin double line where visible. Full photographed statue centered on portrait 1024 x 1536, about 80% height with generous equal white margins. Do not clip hair or the bottom of the visible garment. No lettering, labels, watermark, background, frame or border.

Image2 is ACTUAL SUBJECT: the authentic Yuan-period polychrome clay statue of SHI HUO ZHU 室火猪 from the Twenty-eight Mansions at Fucheng Yuhuang Temple, Zezhou, Shanxi. Draw only this identified single statue, not a generic Buddhist deity and not the entire temple.
Preserve the exact distinctive seated twist and fierce open-mouth face looking upward toward viewer-right, the fan of pointed flame-like hair sweeping upward and to viewer-right, bare chest with necklace, broad drapery over shoulder and hips, exposed right leg dropping down on viewer-left with bare foot visible, left leg bent across toward viewer-right, right hand at the hip on viewer-left, left hand raised low with palm outward on viewer-right. Retain the photographed seat and drapery contours and small pig-animal association as visible on the lap/seat; do not add a separate pig or imaginary animal. Preserve the actual hand and leg count and the photo's modest three-quarter frontal view; do not symmetrize or invent a halo, crown, weapons or extra limbs. Show the entire photographed figure including hair tips and lower drapery, with no added pedestal beneath the extent present in the photo.
Sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces remain white even mouth, hair and eye sockets. Fine confident outlines plus a few fine structural drapery lines. No solid dark patches, hatching, gray, shading, grain, texture or color. Reduce textile patterns to a few selected contours; do not reproduce dense brocade, damage speckles or painted decoration. No background, inscription, watermark, frame, labels or lettering. Portrait 1024 x 1536, full selected figure centered at approximately 80% of height with balanced generous white margins, no clipping.

site_recommendation.lede: 府城玉皇庙把天空中的二十八宿塑成有性情的人物。虚日鼠衣袍层叠、神态安静，小鼠与人的组合让古代天文信仰有了可见的面貌。

facts.label: 星宿人形
facts.text: 二十八宿彩塑把星宿、动物与人物形象结合，姿态和神情各不相同。

facts.label: 元代彩塑
facts.text: 本图采用官方图集中定为元代的虚日鼠，不以北宋重建寺庙的年份代替彩塑年代。

facts.label: 单尊代表
facts.text: 图版只转绘二十八宿中的虚日鼠，省略彩绘纹样与殿内背景，保留手势、衣袍和动物特征。
